variants.name: 01-Holz-Schiefer
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: the provided extremely wide 2D side-scrolling game landscape screenshot. Produce ONE panoramic landscape prototype, not a collage. Preserve the entire composition, sunny mountain meadow background, terrain/grass line, central miner character, central mine opening, left-to-right object order and approximate object sizes and positions. Redesign exactly FOUR foreground map objects as a cohesive family painted by the same game artist: left storage shed with double doors, left-middle blue energy crystal monolith on pedestal, right-middle crystal sales SHOP, far-right WORKSHOP with open workbench and chimney. All FOUR must be fully visible with space between them, sitting correctly on the same grass surface. Same polished hand-painted fantasy 2D sprite style, consistent outline detail, scale, sunlight from upper left, material rendering, rich textures and soft ambient shading across all four; match background painterly quality, no low-poly or flat vector art. Storage is an enclosed shed, shop is a small walk-in stall with visible blue minerals, workshop retains identifiable tools and workbench; monolith remains a prominent glowing cyan-blue standing crystal and shares masonry/metal construction with buildings. Keep the player and terrain unchanged. Buildings retain distinct functional silhouettes but unmistakably share roof, beam, base stone and metalwork designs. Only sign words Shop and Workshop, no variant captions, no UI overlays, no extra buildings, no extra characters, no watermark. Preserve very wide horizontal panorama like reference and show whole scene. Variant 1: warm rustic mining hamlet. Unify around honey-brown oak timber frames, chunky weathered gray stone footings, dark blue-gray slate pitched roofs on ALL THREE buildings (replace straw and flat roof), restrained aged brass brackets, warm amber lanterns. The crystal's gray-stone pedestal has the same slate detailing, oak brace accents and brass corner clamps. Natural handmade proportions, modest detail, welcoming alpine mining village.
